data.about:
Blood type: A

Birth place: Ube, Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan

Co-founder of GAINAX.

In 2006 Anno left GAINAX to form his own studio, Studio Khara.

He's married with fellow mangaka Moyoco Anno.
